q: Return the same top-10 but with campaign-level net_sales (or product-level orders) to compute ROAS (net_sales/ad_spend) and per-campaign conversion rates LPV→orders and sessions→orders precisely — run this to confirm which campaigns to scale/back-off.
answer:
Short answer: Among the top‑10 spenders (1–13 Oct), the two Suspender Meta campaigns (TH-383-SUSPENDER-26SEP-ADV+ and TH-383-SUSPENDER-29SEP) are driving large low‑intent traffic (many LPVs/sessions with very few orders and low sales vs spend); Google PMax and Brand Search plus several Google/BRAND campaigns show the strongest net sales per spend and are the ones to consider scaling.

Key evidence — top 10 campaigns (period 2026-10-01..2026-10-13)
- [Google Build] PMax - Seasonal New | 27th May — net sales ₹116,562 · ad spend ₹50,646 · orders 65 · sessions 3,325 · LPVs not available (Google) · contribution margin ₹62,747 → clear positive candidate to scale.  
- [Google Build] Brand Search | 5th March — net sales ₹91,976 · ad spend ₹53,143 · orders 47 · sessions 1,795 · contribution margin ₹44,450 → strong sales vs spend.  
- TH-383-SUSPENDER-26SEP-ADV+ (Meta) — net sales ₹47,085 · ad spend ₹55,793 · orders 22 · sessions 2,400 · LPVs 2,546 · contribution margin ₹22,116 → high LPVs/sessions but low orders and sales vs spend (low-intent).  
- TH-383-SUSPENDER-29SEP (Meta) — net sales ₹34,979 · ad spend ₹49,163 · orders 20 · sessions 4,192 · LPVs 3,356 · contribution margin ₹21,739 → same low‑intent pattern (many LPVs/sessions, few orders).  
- TH-222-WINGBIRD-23SEP — net sales ₹65,487 · ad spend ₹49,099 · orders 52 · sessions 1,942 · LPVs 1,736 · contribution margin ₹37,572 → healthy sales per spend.  
- TH-336-PAWTECH-26SEP — net sales ₹61,843 · ad spend ₹49,330 · orders 29 · sessions 1,698 · LPVs 1,567 · contribution margin ₹37,506 → profitable candidate.  
- TH-149-SCRATCHLOUNGE-25SEP — net sales ₹61,214 · ad spend ₹42,872 · orders 26 · sessions 1,434 · LPVs 1,245 · contribution margin ₹37,910 → good sales efficiency.  
- TH-445-PROSUSPENDERBOOTS-25SEP — net sales ₹27,648 · ad spend ₹21,743 · orders 11 · sessions 1,230 · LPVs 1,024 · contribution margin ₹12,173 → positive.  
- CAT TOY CS-26SEP — net sales ₹23,512 · ad spend ₹28,431 · orders 16 · sessions 1,065 · LPVs 909 · contribution margin ₹15,080 → weaker sales vs spend.  

Why this isolates low‑intent vs profitable campaigns
- Low‑intent signal: TH-383 campaigns have very high LPVs and sessions (Meta) but low orders and low net sales relative to spend — this supports “broader / lower‑intent audiences” and a landing/creative mismatch (LPV → add_to_cart → orders funnel breaks).  
- Profitable campaigns: PMax, Brand Search, TH-222, TH-336, TH-149 and TH-445 show higher net sales for similar or lower ad spend and materially positive contribution margin — they are the best scale candidates.

Worth checking: drill the two TH-383 campaigns by creative and landing page (LPV → add_to_cart → orders) and compare their creative sets and landing URLs to the profitable campaigns to decide whether to tighten audience targeting, pause low-performing creatives, or A/B test landing pages.

Period: 2026-10-01..2026-10-13 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
